svg.title: aiact_audit_text: checking a text against the AI Act in force today
svg.desc: A terminal types a two-sentence text: "Our hiring assistant is high-risk under Annex III; the obligations apply from 2 August 2026. Under Article 10(5) we may process special categories of personal data to detect bias." The tool returns two errors. First, outdated deadline: "2 August 2026" is now 2 December 2027, changed by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744. Second, removed provision: "Article 10(5)"; the text moved to Article 4a(1). Footer: 2 findings, checked against the text in force on the given date, no LLM involved.
svg.text: › Check this text against the AI Act in force today:
